meta.title: GitHub open-source radar
meta.description: Extracts keywords from every new request, searches GitHub once before answering, and lists reusable open-source projects with stars, language, license and last push.

config.enabled: Turn the policy and the github_search tool on or off.
config.maxResults: Maximum repositories the answer may list (1-10).
config.minStars: Only return repositories with at least this many stars.
config.language: Default GitHub language filter, for example TypeScript. Empty means no filter.
config.includeArchived: Keep archived repositories in the results.
config.cacheTtlMs: How long one search result stays cached, in milliseconds. 0 turns the cache off.
config.tokenEnv: Name of the environment variable that holds a GitHub token.
